value.rationale: This determines the complete singularity incidence lattice of the natural 24-line arrangement associated with one of the most symmetric genus-three curves. Its all-node behavior contrasts with high-multiplicity flex arrangements and supplies the full local combinatorics needed for arrangement complements, logarithmic bundles and freeness questions, rather than a contrived numerical slice.
